scope: LIVE frontend release and production Git baseline repair
trigger: A later main-branch build removed LEARN from the customer menu despite the earlier verified release.

approved_immediate_restore.action: User-approved Force Promote of the exact previously verified LEARN deployment
approved_immediate_restore.result: All four existing LIVE aliases mapped to the READY deployment; a fresh signed-in Drummonds menu and LEARN page opened.

durable_git_repair.method: Fast-forward main to a merge commit retaining both published histories and the verified LEARN source tree, then retain main's two public environment example files.
durable_git_repair.backup_workflows: Both existing database backup and missed-success monitor workflow files matched the previous main byte for byte.
durable_git_repair.local_verification: TypeScript passed; production build passed with all 47 prebuild checks.
durable_git_repair.git_remote_check: Previous main and LEARN checkpoint remote heads matched the reviewed IDs immediately before the fast-forward push. No force push or published-history rewrite was used.

final_live_readback.signed_in: Fresh app.openfolk.ai reload showed the Drummonds LEARN menu and opened the LEARN page with saved records and Slack evidence controls.

limits: This frontend repair does not complete Slack backlog coverage, the full working-day observation, full application recovery, scoring acceptance, or Chris's business signoff.
